blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Modern video models can synthesize realistic videos from complementary appearance and geometry conditions: real reference images specify how the scene should look, while proxy RGB and geometric control videos depict its structure, viewpoint changes, and motion.
Yet this reference-conditioned render-to-real capability remains difficult to evaluate because its output must be compared with a ground-truth real video depicting the same scene evolution.
A rigorous benchmark therefore needs appearance references and target real videos paired with editable, geometrically registered 3D replicas, a resource that has traditionally required prohibitive manual modeling, calibration, and animation effort.
Existing evaluations therefore rely on controls estimated from real videos or on small collections of synthetic scenes, neither of which provides paired real appearance and editable scene state at scale.
We introduce RenderBench, a benchmark comprising 12reconstructed real-world scenes that span large-scale indoor environments and egocentric viewpoints, with both dynamic and static settings.
The scenes are constructed using modern visual geometry, neural reconstruction, and assisted 3D authoring.
Each scene is decomposed into static objects and dynamic actors, registered to the capture cameras, and admitted only after multi-view geometric and temporal validation.
An accepted unit contains held-out appearance references, a real target video, an editable digital twin, a matched proxy render, and renderer-native scene annotations.
We evaluate transfer models against paired real target videos, retain PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections, and use scene annotations to localize failures by object, visibility, articulation, and motion.
The first release retains 12 of 14 registered samples (85.7%), comprising 1,496 paired real–proxy frames; all 12 scenes pass file-integrity and environment-edit audits, while proxy diagnostics yield a depth si-RMSE of 0.2170 and instance mIoU of 0.3673.
blocks.zh:
现代视频模型可以从互补外观和几何条件合成出现实的视频:真实的参考图像指定了场景应当如何外观,而代理RGB和几何控制视频则描绘出其结构,视角变化和运动.
然而,这种以参照条件为条件的制成实际的能力仍然难以评估,因为其产出必须与描绘同一场景演变的地面真实录像相提并论。
因此,严格的基准需要外观参考和目标真实的视频与可编辑的、几何注册的3D复制品配对,而这种资源传统上需要令人望而却步的手工制作、校准和动画。
因此,现有的评价依赖于从真实视频或合成场景小集中估计出来的控制,两者都无法提供成对的真实外观和可编辑的场景状态。
我们引入了伦德·本奇(Render Bench)这个基准,由12个重建的现实世界场景组成,它们跨越了大规模的室内环境和以自负为中心的观点,既有动态环境,也有静态环境.
场景采用现代视觉几何构造,神经重建,并辅助了3D作曲.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Computer-graphics simulators offer a compelling source of training data for robotics, autonomous driving, and embodied intelligence.
They provide scalable trajectories together with exact geometry, object state, segmentation, depth, and motion.
Their central limitation is the synthetic-to-real appearance gap [ 16 ] .
Recent video generators directly target this limitation by combining two complementary sources of information.
One or more real reference images specify the desired appearance, including materials, illumination, and scene style, while a geometry video depicts the scene structure, viewpoint changes, object motion, and articulation to preserve.
The geometry condition may be a proxy RGB render or dense render passes such as depth, segmentation, edges, pose, or trajectories.
Structured-control systems such as Cosmos-Transfer2.5 [ 10 ] and Wan2.2-VACE-Fun-A14B [ 1 ] expose these signals explicitly, whereas general multimodal systems such as MiniMax H3 [ 8 ] and Seedance 2.5 [ 2 ] consume them through reference and editing interfaces.
Together, these systems establish reference-conditioned render-to-real transfer as an emerging capability across structured-control and general-purpose video models.
blocks.zh:
计算机制图模拟器为机器人、自主驾驶和体现智能提供了令人信服的培训数据来源。
它们与精确的几何,物体状态,分化,深度,和运动一起提供可伸缩的轨迹.
其中心限制是合成-现实外观差距 [16].
最近的视频生成器将两个互补的信息来源结合起来,直接针对这一限制。
一个或多个真实的参考图像指定了所期望的外观,包括材料,发光,和场景风格等,而一款几何视频则描绘了场景结构,视角变化,物体运动,以及表达来保存.
几何条件可以是代理 RGB 渲染或密集渲染的传出,如深度,分化,边缘,姿势,或轨迹等.
Cosmos-Transfer2.5[10]和Wan2.2-VACE-Fun-A14B等结构化控制系统 [1] 明确暴露这些信号,而一般多式系统,如MiniMax H3[8]和种子2.5[2],则通过参考和编辑接口消耗这些信号。
这些系统共同建立了有参考条件的制成到实际的传输,作为跨结构控制和通用视频模型的一种新兴能力。

blocks.en:
This new capability creates an evaluation problem that existing datasets cannot fully answer.
Existing resources cover complementary pieces of the problem, but not the full evaluation loop.
CO3D provides nearly 19,000 object-centric real videos with recovered cameras and point clouds, but no independently authored, editable proxy whose render can be used as a transfer input [ 13 ] .
Aria Digital Twin (ADT) comes closest to paired real–synthetic supervision: its 200 published sequences include calibrated egocentric recordings, a carefully digitized scene, and photorealistic synthetic renderings [ 12 ] .
However, those sequences span only two instrumented spaces, and their construction relies on high-resolution scanning, manual scene digitization, material and lighting tuning, and motion capture; ADT is designed for egocentric 3D perception rather than scalable evaluation from deliberately simplified renderer inputs.
AptSim2Real instead offers approximately paired driving images whose simulated and real scenes may differ in assets, shape, texture, and appearance, making it suitable for distribution-level translation but not same-scene structural verification [ 22 ] .
Finally, Cosmos TransferBench and PAI-Bench-C evaluate controls extracted from real videos, while the Cosmos Sim2Real case study uses 20 programmatically authored robot scenarios; neither couples those inputs to real captures of the same editable scenes [ 9 , 24 ] .
To determine whether a transfer model merely produces a plausible video or actually reconstructs the intended real-looking scene, evaluation requires four aligned elements: appearance references, a geometry video, a held-out real target video, and an editable 3D scene.
The reference images are model inputs that specify the desired real appearance; the geometry video is the model input that depicts the target viewpoint changes and scene evolution without exposing the underlying camera parameters; the temporally matched real video is held out as the appearance ground truth; and the registered editable 3D scene provides renderer-native geometry and dynamics for diagnostic analysis.
Together they distinguish successful transfer from three common shortcuts: copying the synthetic input without realification, reproducing a reference image without following the requested motion, and generating an attractive but structurally different video.
blocks.zh:
这种新的能力造成了一个评价问题,现有数据集无法完全解决。
现有资源涵盖了问题的补充部分,但不涵盖完整的评价循环。
CO3D提供近19,000个以对象为中心的真实视频,并配有回收相机和点云,但没有独立作者,可编辑的代理,其渲染可用作传输输入 [13].
Aria Digital Twin(ADT)最接近成对的真-合成监督:其200个已公布的序列包括校正自心的录音,一个精心数字化的场景,以及光现实主义合成渲染[12].
然而,这些序列仅跨越两个仪器空间,其构造依赖于高分辨率扫描、人工场景数字化、材料和照明调和以及运动捕捉;ADT是针对以自我为中心的3D感知设计的,而不是通过故意简化的渲染器输入进行可扩展评价。
AptSim2 Real转而提供大约成对的驱动图像,其模拟和真实的场景在资产,外形,纹理和外观上可能有所不同,使其适合发行级翻译而并不适合同场结构验证[22].
最后,Cosmos Transfer Bench和PAI-Bench-C评价从真实视频中提取的控件,而Cosmos Sim2Real案例研究则使用20个程序化的由编导的机器人情景;两对对真实地捕捉到同一可编辑场景的输入均没有[9,24].
为了确定一个传输模型是仅仅产生一个可信的视频,还是实际上重建了预期真实的场景,评价需要四个对齐的元素:外观参考,几何视频,被搁置的真实目标视频,以及可编辑的3D场景.
参考图像是指定所期望的真实外观的模型输入;几何视频是描绘目标视角变化和场景演化而未暴露所基于相机参数的模型输入;时间匹配的真实视频被保持为外观地面真实;注册可编辑的3D场景为诊断分析提供渲染-本土几何和动态.
它们共同区分成功传输与三种常见快捷键:复制合成输入而未实现,复制参考图像而未遵循所请求的动作,并生成有吸引力但结构不同的视频.

blocks.en:
Historically, this evaluation unit has been impractical to collect at benchmark scale.
Building a faithful, editable 3D replica of an ordinary real scene required skilled artists to model and place assets, reproduce materials and lighting, calibrate cameras, rig articulated agents, and synchronize motion.
Photogrammetry and neural view synthesis reduced parts of this burden, but their outputs were often difficult to edit, animate, or convert into the clean renderer-native state required for controlled evaluation.
The missing resource is therefore not simply a larger video collection, but a repeatable way to build and validate such paired evaluation units across ordinary physical scenes.
Without it, newer structured-control and reference-video models cannot be compared under equivalent scene content with both real appearance evidence and renderer-native structural truth.
blocks.zh:
从历史上看,这个评价单位在基准规模上收集是不切实际的。
打造一个忠实、可编辑的普通真实场景3D复制品,需要熟练的艺术家制作和配置资产、复制材料和照明、校准相机、钻机装配剂和同步运动。
摄影测量和神经视图合成减轻了部分这种负担,但其产出往往难以编辑、动画化或转化为控制评价所需的清洁成像-内在状态。
因此,缺失的资源不仅仅是一个更大的视频收藏,而是在普通物理场景中建立和验证这种对等评价单元的可重复方式.
没有它,在等同的场景内容下,无法将较新的结构控制模型和参考视频模型与真实的外观证据和渲染器-内在结构真伪进行比较.

blocks.en:
The premise of RenderBench is that recent progress changes this feasibility boundary.
3D Gaussian Splatting enables fast high-quality reconstruction and rendering of captured scenes [ 5 ] ; DUSt3R [ 19 ] and VGGT [ 18 ] substantially reduce the calibration and geometry burden; and multimodal authoring agents can operate professional 3D tools over long workflows [ 11 ] .
These systems do not by themselves guarantee metric fidelity, but they change the labor and iteration cost of producing a candidate digital twin.
Geometric registration and explicit acceptance tests can then convert that candidate into benchmark-grade data.
blocks.zh:
Render Bench的前提是,最近的进展改变了这种可行性界限。
3D高斯平板化能快速高质量地重建并渲染被捕获的场景 [5]; DUST3R [19]和VGGT [18]能大幅度地减轻校正和几何重负;而多模式的编写代理可以运行专业的3D工具来超越长的工作流程 [11].
这些系统本身并不能保证衡量忠诚,但它们改变了生产候选数字双胞胎的劳动力和迭代成本。
然后,几何登记和明确验收测试可以将该候选人转换为基准级数据。

blocks.en:
We therefore make benchmark construction , rather than a new scalar metric, the central contribution.
Starting from a captured scene, our assisted pipeline reconstructs editable assets, recovers the camera trajectory, fits object and articulated motion, and iteratively compares rendered views with the observations.
Each scene passes quantitative multi-view and state-consistency gates before release.
The resulting paired data supports appearance comparison to reality and diagnostic analysis against the accepted renderer state.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们把基准建设而不是新的衡量标准作为中心贡献。
从一个被捕获的场景开始,我们的辅助管道重建了可编辑的资产,恢复了相机轨迹,符合物体和清晰的动作,并迭接地将所发表的观点与观测结果相提并论.
每个场景在释放前都会经过定量多视图和状态相符合的大门.
由此产生的配对数据支持外观与现实的比较,并对照公认的渲染器状态进行诊断分析.

blocks.en: Our contributions are: • We identify the missing substrate for reference-conditioned render-to-real evaluation: appearance reference images and ground-truth real videos paired with validated, editable, and dynamically registered 3D twins of the same scenes. • We introduce a scalable construction pipeline that combines visual geometry, neural reconstruction, and assisted 3D authoring with explicit geometric and temporal acceptance gates. • We construct RenderBench from 12reconstructed real-world scenes spanning large-scale indoor environments and egocentric viewpoints, with both dynamic and static settings, providing held-out appearance references, paired real target videos and geometry renders, together with renderer-native depth, masks, landmarks, visibility, flow, camera, and articulation metadata. • We benchmark representative transfer systems against paired real target videos, retain PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections, and use the paired scene state to analyze where aggregate scores conceal object, articulation, occlusion, and motion failures.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献是: 我们确定缺失的基于参考条件的渲染与真实评价的底物:外观参考图像和地面真实的视频,配有经过验证、可编辑和动态注册的3D双胞胎。 我们引进了可伸缩的建筑管线,将视觉几何,神经重建结合起来,并协助3D作者有明显的几何和时间接受门. —— 我们从12个经过重建的现实世界的场景中构建出Render Bench,这些场景跨越了大规模的室内环境和以自负为中心的观点,既有动态环境,也有静态环境,提供了被搁置的外观参考,配对了真实的目标视频和几何等,再加上渲染器的深度、口罩、地标、能见度、流出、相机和发音元数据。 我们把具有代表性的传输系统比对成对真实的目标视频,保留PAI-Bench-C相容的结构预测,并使用成对的场景状态来分析集合分数隐藏物体,表达,隐蔽,运动失败之处.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Render-to-Real Video Generation
blocks.zh: 2.1 制作录像

blocks.en:
Pix2pix [ 4 ] , CycleGAN [ 25 ] , and vid2vid [ 20 ] established paired, unpaired, and temporal translation paradigms.
Modern diffusion transfer models substantially improve photorealism, but can still hallucinate geometry or alter motion.
Generic video-generation evaluation includes distributional metrics such as FVD and multi-dimensional suites such as EvalCrafter and VBench [ 17 , 6 , 3 ] ; unlike RenderBench, they do not assume a frame-aligned real target and editable scene state for each generated video.
blocks.zh:
Pix2pix [4], CycleGAN [25],和vid2vid [20] 已建立对接,未发音,以及时间翻译范式.
现代传播传导模型大大地改进了光现实主义,但仍能幻出几何或改变运动.
通用视频生成评价包括FVD等分布度量衡以及EvalCrafter和V Bench等多维套件[17,6,3];与Render Bench不同,它们并不假设每个生成的视频都有一个帧相匹配的真实目标并可以编辑的场景状态.

blocks.en:
Cosmos-Transfer1 [ 9 ] formulates multimodal controllable world generation from visual, edge, depth, and segmentation inputs, explicitly motivating these controls as a way to make CG renders realistic while preserving scene structure and semantics.
Its TransferBench contains 600 real videos and measures control adherence, diversity, and technical quality.
For robotics Sim2Real, it additionally evaluates 20 programmatically generated manipulation scenes with six prompts each.
This work demonstrates both the promise of render-to-real generation and the current construction bottleneck: broad real-video evaluation lacks scene-native 3D truth, while 3D-grounded Sim2Real evaluation remains small and synthetic-only.
blocks.zh:
Cosmos-Transfer1[9]从视觉、边缘、深度和分解输入形成可控多模式世界代,明确激发这些控制,使CG在保持场景结构和语义的同时具有现实性。
它的"转移奔驰"包含600个真实的视频,并采取措施控制遵守,多样性和技术质量.
对于机器人Sim2Real,它额外评价了20个程序生成的操纵场景,每个场景有6个提示.
这部作品既展现出渲染到真实生成的希望,也展现出目前的建筑瓶颈:广义的真象评价缺乏场景原生的3D真象,而由3D定位的Sim2真象评价仍然是小而只合成.

blocks.en:
Cosmos-Transfer2.5 [ 10 ] extends the specialized Control2World line with multiple spatial video modalities, image prompting, longer autoregressive generation, and simulation-to-photorealism workflows.
Wan2.2-VACE-Fun-A14B [ 1 ] provides a second open structured-control family with generic control videos, reference images, pose, depth, edge, trajectory, and camera variants.
MiniMax H3 [ 8 ] instead exposes a general multimodal reference interface and explicitly supports video-to-video motion transfer.
Seedance 2.5 [ 2 ] similarly emphasizes precise video reference, editing, white-model control, and longer generation.
These interfaces are not identical, but all can be asked to realify a proxy scene while retaining specified content or motion.
This diversity strengthens the need for a model-agnostic benchmark and motivates separate structured-control and video-reference tracks.
blocks.zh:
Cosmos-Transfer2.5 [10] 扩展了专门的Control2World线路,采用多种空间视频模式,图像提示,更长时间的自递生成,模拟到相片现实主义工作流程.
Wan2.2-VACE-Fun-A14B [1] 提供了第二个开放式结构控制家族,拥有通用控制视频,参考图像,姿势,深度,边缘,轨迹,和相机变体.
相反地,MiniMax H3 [8] 暴露出一般的多式参考界面,并明确支持视频到视频运动转移.
种子 2.5 [2] 类似地强调精确的视频参考,编辑,白色模型控制,以及更长的生成.
这些接口并不完全相同,但可以要求所有接口在保留指定内容或运动的同时重新定义代理场景.
这种多样性加强了对模型不可知性基准的需要,并激发了单独的结构化控制和视频参考轨道。

blocks.en: 2.2 Benchmarks and Paired Real–Synthetic Data
blocks.zh: 2.2 基准和真实-综合数据

blocks.en:
PAI-Bench [ 24 ] generalizes this evaluation into generation, conditional-generation, and understanding tracks for Physical AI.
PAI-Bench-C extracts blur, edge, depth, and segmentation controls from real videos and reports Blur SSIM, Edge F1, Depth si-RMSE, Mask mIoU, DOVER technical quality, and LPIPS diversity.
RenderBench retains the edge, depth, and segmentation projections for compatibility, but uses paired real target videos as its primary reference rather than adopting the complete protocol or proposing a new aggregate metric.
Its contribution is a different evaluation substrate: paired real observations and editable 3D twins that allow errors to be analyzed by object, visibility, articulation, and motion.
blocks.zh:
PAI-Bench [24] 将这一评价概括为生成,有条件生成,以及物理AI的理解轨迹.
PAI-Bench-C从真实视频和报告Blur SSIM,Edge F1,Depth si-RMSE,Mask mIoU,DOVER技术质量,LPIPS多样性中提取出模糊,边缘,深度和分化控制.
Render Bench保留了相容性的边缘,深度和分块预测,但使用成对的真目标视频作为其主要参考,而不是采用完整的协议或提出新的汇总度量.
它的贡献是不同的评价底物:对正观测和可编辑的3D双胞胎,允许通过对象,能见度,表达和运动来分析出错误.

blocks.en:
CO3D [ 13 ] supplies large-scale object-centric real videos, camera poses, and reconstructed point clouds for category-level reconstruction and novel-view synthesis, but does not standardize an independently built proxy-render input.
ADT [ 12 ] supplies unusually accurate real–synthetic correspondence, full calibration, scene and object geometry, and photorealistic renderings.
It is the closest data precedent to ours, but differs in both objective and construction regime: ADT targets egocentric perception in two intensively digitized, motion-captured spaces, whereas RenderBench targets scalable diagnosis of transfer from deliberately simplified, editable renders of diverse captured scenes.
AptSim2Real [ 22 ] studies approximately paired image translation; its real and simulated examples need not depict the identical geometry, precluding renderer-native measurement of same-scene preservation.
blocks.zh:
CO3D [13] 提供大规模以对象为中心的真实视频,相机外观,并重建出点云,用于分类级重建与小说-取景合成,但并未将独立构建的代理-传输输入标准化.
ADT [12] 提供异常准确的真-合成通信,全校正,场景和物体几何,以及相片现实化的渲染.
这是与我们最接近的数据先例,但客观和建筑制度上都不同:ADT针对的是两个密集数字化的、可移动的空间中自我中心感,而Render Bench针对的是从各种被捕获场景中故意简化、可编辑的可扩展的转移诊断。
AptSim2 Real [22] 研究大约对映图像翻译;其真实和模拟的例子不需要描绘出相同的几何学,排除了同场景保存的渲染-内在测量.

blocks.en: 2.3 Building Editable Digital Twins
blocks.zh: 2.3 可编辑的数字双胞胎

blocks.en:
Classical structure from motion and multi-view stereo provide geometric scene reconstruction but require sufficiently overlapping imagery and substantial cleanup [ 14 ] .
3D Gaussian Splatting [ 5 ] improves the quality and speed of novel-view reconstruction, and Dynamic 3D Gaussians extends this representation to persistent dynamic tracking [ 7 ] , while DUSt3R [ 19 ] directly predicts point maps from uncalibrated image collections.
VGGT [ 18 ] further predicts cameras, depth, point maps, and tracks in a feed-forward pass.
These representations supply geometry and appearance evidence, but benchmark construction also needs editable objects, semantic organization, clean topology, articulation, and reproducible rendering.
blocks.zh:
由运动和多景立体构成的经典结构提供几何场景重建,但需要足够重叠的图像并进行实质性清理[14].
3D高斯平板造型[5]提高了小说-取景重建的质量和速度,动态3D高斯平板造型将这种表现扩展到了持续的动态跟踪[7],而DUST3R [19]则直接从未校正的图像集中预测出点图.
VGGT [18] 进一步预测相机,深度,点地图,以及一条向后传送的行走道中的轨迹.
这些表述提供了几何和外观证据,但基准构建还需要可编辑对象,语义组织,清洁地貌,表达,再生渲染.

blocks.en:
GPT-6 Astra is a general reasoning and computer-use model rather than a dedicated geometric estimator.
Nevertheless, its demonstrated ability to reconstruct CAD objects from multi-view renders and carry out Blender-to-Unreal scene workflows [ 11 ] is important for our setting: an agent can connect specialized reconstruction outputs with asset modeling, scene organization, scripting, rendering, and visual iteration.
RenderBench treats this capability as one possible construction accelerator, not as ground truth or a required model component; every resulting twin must pass the same independent validation.
blocks.zh:
GPT-6 Astra是一种一般推理和计算机使用模型,而不是专用的几何估计器.
尽管如此,它表现出的从多视图重建 CAD 对象的能力使 Blender-to-unreal s景色工作流程 [11] 对我们的设置很重要:一个代理可以将专门的重建产出与资产模型、场景组织、脚本、渲染和视觉迭代连接起来。
Render Bench将这种能力视为一种可能的构造加速器,而不是地面真理或所需的模型组件;每个产生的双胞胎都必须通过同样的独立验证.

blocks.en:
Figure 2 : Construction and evaluation pipeline of RenderBench.
Multi-view observations are converted into a validated digital twin with editable objects, articulated actors, and aligned cameras.
Transfer models receive appearance references and an aligned proxy video, while the matched real target remains evaluator-only.
Generated outputs are compared directly with the real target using paired-reference metrics, while PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections and paired scene state support diagnostic analysis.

多视图观测被转换成一个经验证的数字双子,并配有可编辑对象,可表达出演员,并配对相机.

blocks.zh: 3 基准设定

The desired output follows the appearance specified by I ref I^{\mathrm{ref}} , matches the held-out real target Y gt Y^{\mathrm{gt}} , and preserves the scene and trajectory encoded by ( 𝒮 , C ) (\mathcal{S},C) .
Because reconstruction is never perfect, we publish a validity mask and registration uncertainty for every sequence; evaluation excludes pixels and states outside the accepted support.

blocks.en: 3.2 Renderer-Native Scene Annotations
blocks.zh: 3.2 渲染器-自然场景说明

blocks.en: 3.3 Conditioning and Evaluation Roles
blocks.zh: 3.3 条件和评价作用

blocks.en:
The appearance images, real target video, and digital twin serve distinct roles.
The model observes I ref I^{\mathrm{ref}} as the appearance condition but never observes the scored frames of Y gt Y^{\mathrm{gt}} .
The ground-truth video evaluates illumination, material response, sensor appearance, image detail, and temporal realism along the requested trajectory.
The accepted 3D scene provides a reference for analyzing geometry, object identity, visibility, motion, and articulation.
No source is silently treated as perfect outside its designated role.
blocks.zh:
外观影像,真实的目标视频,和数字双相为不同的角色服务.
模型观察到我将I^{\-mathrm{ref}}-作为外观条件,但从未观察到YgtY^{\-mathrm{gt}}-的得分框.
地面真实视频评价了照亮,物质反应,传感器外观,图像细节,以及所要求轨迹上的时间现实主义.
被接受的3D场景为分析几何,物体身份,能见度,运动,和表达提供了参考.
没有任何来源在其指定作用之外被无声地视为完美无缺。

blocks.en: 3.4 Task Setting
blocks.zh: 3.4 任务设置

blocks.en:
At test time, every transfer model receives exactly two semantic inputs: the real appearance references I ref I^{\mathrm{ref}} and the geometry-proxy video X geo X^{\mathrm{geo}} .
The model must infer the target viewpoint change and scene evolution from X geo X^{\mathrm{geo}} , render them in the appearance specified by I ref I^{\mathrm{ref}} , and produce Y ^ \hat{Y} without observing Y gt Y^{\mathrm{gt}} , A eval A^{\mathrm{eval}} , or explicit camera information.
The benchmark fixes the number of reference images and the representation of X geo X^{\mathrm{geo}} for each comparison.
Different model APIs may package the pair through image-reference, video-editing, or structured-control interfaces, but adapters may not introduce any additional semantic condition.
blocks.zh:
在测试时间,每个传输模型都得到精确的两种语义输入:真实的外观参考 I ref I-^{\mathrm{ref}}}和几何-代用视频 X Geo-X^{\mathrm{geo}}.
该模型必须从 X geo geo 中推断目标视角的变化和场景演化, 使其在 I ref I mathrm{ref} 指定的外观中进行, 并生成 Y ^\ hat{Y} 而无需观察 Y gt Y mathrm{gt} 、 A eval A^{\ mathrm{eval} 或 清晰相机信息 。
基准确定每个比较的参考图像数量和X地平面的表示。
不同型号 API可以通过图像参考,视频编辑,或结构化控制接口来包装对子,但适配器可能不会引入任何额外的语义条件.

blocks.en: 4 Constructing RenderBench
blocks.zh: 4 建构边框

blocks.en: 4.1 Why Construction Was the Bottleneck
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 为什么建筑是博特伦克

blocks.en:
The desired benchmark is not a collection of attractive 3D assets.
Every scene must be recognizably and geometrically tied to a real capture, editable enough to expose semantic objects and articulation, and accurate enough to render the observed camera path.
Traditional manual construction satisfies these requirements but does not scale at an acceptable cost.
Pure neural view synthesis scales better but generally lacks the clean meshes, semantics, joints, and physical editability needed for controlled rendering.
blocks.zh:
理想的基准不是收集有吸引力的三维资产。
每个场景都必须能辨识出,并用几何方式与真实的捕捉相接上,可以编辑到足够暴露语义对象并发音,准确到足以使被观测到的相机路径.
传统的人工施工满足了这些要求,但是没有以可接受的成本进行规模建设。
纯神经视图合成尺度更好,但一般缺乏控制渲染所需的清洁网格,语义,关节和物理可编辑性.

blocks.en: 4.2 Digital-Twin Construction Pipeline
blocks.zh: 4.2 数字双向建筑管道

blocks.en:
Given synchronized multi-view observations, the pipeline constructs an editable digital twin containing static geometry, semantic object instances, materials, lighting, calibrated cameras, and time-varying object and articulation states.
Static geometry and dynamic actors are reconstructed separately and then registered in a common metric coordinate system.
This separation is important: static objects require accurate shape and layout, whereas dynamic actors additionally require temporally stable identity and articulation.
blocks.zh:
鉴于同步的多视图观测,管道构建了一个可编辑的数字双胞胎,包含静态几何,语义对象实例,材料,照明,校准相机,以及时间变化的物体和表达状态.
静态几何和动态角色被分别重建,然后在通用的度量坐标系统中注册.
这种分离很重要:静态物体需要准确的外形和布局,而动态角色则需要时间稳定的特性和表达.

blocks.en:
We record calibrated multi-view images or videos with scale anchors and synchronized views for dynamic sequences where available.
DUSt3R/VGGT initialize cameras, geometry, depth, and tracks [ 19 , 18 ] , while 3D Gaussian Splatting provides an appearance reference for novel-view comparison [ 5 ] .
These estimates are initializations rather than benchmark ground truth.
Camera parameters and scene scale are jointly checked against multi-view correspondences and physical anchors before downstream reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
我们记录校正的多视图图像或视频,并配有比例主播,并同步查看动态序列。
DUST3R/VGGT初始化相机,几何,深度,和轨 [19,18],而3D高斯平板为小说-视角比较提供了外观参考 [5].
这些估计数是初始化的,而不是基准基础真相。
相机参数和场景尺度在下游重建前与多景通信及实体锚进行联合检查.

blocks.en:
The scene is decomposed into architecture and semantic object instances.
Multi-view masks and reconstruction estimates initialize each object’s geometry and pose.
The geometry and layout are refined against silhouettes, robust depth agreement, and multi-view correspondences, with regularization used where observations are incomplete.
The optimization is performed per object and jointly for scene layout, so a low whole-image error cannot hide a misplaced small object.
Stable instance identities are retained across views, scene assets, and renderer annotations.
blocks.zh:
该场景被分解为架构和语义对象实例.
多视图口罩和重建估计初始化了每个物体的几何和外观.
几何和布局参照硅相接来细化,强烈的深度一致,多视图对应,在观测不完整的地方采用正态化.
优化是每个对象进行,并为场景布局联合进行,因此低等全像出错不能隐藏出错的小对象.
各种观点、现场资产和渲染器说明都保留了稳定的实例身份。

blocks.en: Table 1 : Dataset release audit and proxy-quality diagnostics. Bracketed values denote the reported scene-level intervals.
blocks.zh: 表1:数据集发布审计和代理质量诊断. 括号中值表示报告的场景级别间隔.

blocks.en:
Humans and robots are reconstructed as sequence-level articulated models rather than independent per-frame meshes.
A fixed topology and articulation structure are initialized once, after which root pose and joint states 𝒬 1 : T \mathcal{Q}_{1:T} are fitted to multi-view keypoints, silhouettes, and trajectories.
Temporal regularization suppresses implausible velocity and acceleration, while contact constraints align grasp, release, and support events with manipulated objects.
Visibility weights suppress unsupported constraints during occlusion instead of forcing a per-frame fit.
Fixed topology, link lengths, and semantic attachments prevent identity and scale drift while preserving editable articulation.
blocks.zh:
人类和机器人被重建为序列级的清晰模型,而不是独立的每帧网格.
固定的地貌和拼接结构被初始化一次,之后根姿和联合状态为Q 1 : T\ mathcal{Q}_{1:T} 被安装到多视图键点, silhoettes, 和轨迹.
时间规范化抑制了不可信的速度和加速,而接触限制则使被被操纵物体的抓取,放出和支持事件一致.
可见分量在被隔离期间抑制了无支持的制约,而不是强制进行一帧相合.
固定地貌,链接长度,和语义附件在保留可编辑的表达的同时可以防止身份和尺度漂移.

blocks.en:
The construction agent proposes candidate scene edits from reconstruction residuals and diagnostic renders, while ambiguous identities and topology are resolved by an operator.
The same acceptance tests apply regardless of how a candidate was produced.
Geometry and motion are frozen before materials and lighting are refined, preventing appearance optimization from concealing structural errors.
blocks.zh:
建筑代理商提议从重建后遗症和诊断结果中进行候选场景编辑,而模棱两可的身份和地貌则由操作员解决。
不论候选人是如何生产的,都适用同样的验收标准。
几何和运动在材料和照明被精炼之前被冻结,使外观优化无法掩盖结构错误.

blocks.en:
Static geometry, articulated motion, cameras, materials, and lighting are assembled into an editable digital twin.
Validation uses views and frames withheld from fitting whenever capture coverage permits.
A scene is accepted only when camera reprojection, masked depth agreement, instance silhouette overlap, landmark accuracy, temporal smoothness, event timing, and held-out-view appearance satisfy pre-registered thresholds.
Acceptance is evaluated both globally and per semantic object, with visibility-dependent thresholds for small or partially occluded instances.
Regions that remain ambiguous are excluded through the released validity masks rather than silently treated as accurate geometry.
Failed scenes are repaired or excluded, and construction error is propagated to the uncertainty analysis in Sec. 5 .
blocks.zh:
静态几何,清晰的运动,相机,材料,和照明被组装成可编辑的数字双相.
验证使用在获取覆盖许可时不使用的视图和框架。
只有当相机再投影,遮掩深度协议,实例 silhouette重叠,地标精度,时间平滑,事件时间,被持有外观的外观满足预先注册的阈值时,才被接受.
接受评价既有全球性的,也有语义性的,对于小的或部分被接受的情况,有视能阈值。
仍然模棱两可的区域通过释放的有效性口罩被排除在外,而不是沉默地视为准确的几何。
失败的场景被修复或排除,施工错误被传播到第5节的不确定性分析中.

blocks.en: 4.3 Dataset Contents
blocks.zh: 4.3 数据集内容

blocks.en:
Each accepted unit contains held-out appearance reference images, the ground-truth real target video, an editable scene package, calibrated camera trajectory, and the proxy RGB geometry video.
Its evaluator-only annotations include depth, normals, optical flow, semantic/instance masks, stable object identifiers, landmarks, visibility, articulation state, event labels, validity masks, and uncertainty estimates.
Construction metadata records capture provenance, coordinate conventions, and validation results.
The first release contains 12reconstructed real-world scenes spanning large-scale indoor environments and egocentric viewpoints, including dynamic scenes with moving or articulated actors as well as static scenes.
Figure 3 summarizes the dataset diversity and paired supervision.
blocks.zh:
每个被接受的单位都包含被搁置的外观参考图像,地-实真实目标视频,可编辑的场景套装,校正相机轨迹,以及代理RGB几何视频.
其评价员专用的说明包括深度、常态、光学流、语义/内涵口罩、稳定的物体识别器、地标、能见度、表达状态、事件标签、有效性口罩和不确定性估计。
建筑元数据记录采集出处,协调公约,验证结果.
第一版包含12个经过重构的现实世界场景,这些场景跨越了大规模的室内环境和以自负为中心的观点,包括动态场景有感人或表现的演员以及静态场景.
图3总结了数据集的多样性和配对监督。

blocks.en:
Figure 3 : Dataset diversity and paired supervision in RenderBench.
The 12reconstructed scenes span large-scale indoor environments and egocentric viewpoints, with both dynamic and static settings.
Each real capture is paired with an editable digital twin, aligned proxy renders, and renderer-native scene annotations.
blocks.zh:
图3:Render Bench的数据集多样性和配对监督。
由12个重建而成的场景跨越了大规模的室内环境和以自负为中心的观点,既有动态的,也有静态的.
每个真实的捕捉都配有可编辑的数字双胞胎,对齐的代理制作,以及渲染器-内景说明.

blocks.en: 4.4 Model-Interface Adapters
blocks.zh: 4.4 模型-界面适应器

blocks.en:
The same scene unit is packaged through standardized adapters rather than forcing every model into one API.
For structured-control models, adapters provide a fixed budget of real appearance reference images and export the supported proxy RGB, depth, segmentation, edge, pose, and object-trajectory videos with fixed normalization.
For general reference models, adapters provide the same appearance references and the proxy RGB geometry clip.
Adapters never expose camera intrinsics, extrinsics, or trajectories; viewpoint change is encoded only through the rendered geometry videos.
Every submission manifest records the information actually exposed to the model.
Primary comparisons are made within matched information budgets; cross-track plots are descriptive rather than leaderboard ranks.
blocks.zh:
同一个场景单元通过标准化的适配器来包装,而不是将每个模型强迫一个API.
对于结构化控制模型,适配器提供真实外观参考图像的固定预算,并导出支持的代理RGB,深度,分块,边缘,姿势,以及具有固定常态的对象-外观视频.
对于一般参考模型,适配器提供相同的外观参考和代理RGB几何剪接.
适配器从不暴露相机的内在,外相或轨迹;观点变化只能通过渲染的几何视频来编码.
每一份提交清单都记录实际接触到模型的信息。
主要比较是在相匹配的信息预算范围内进行的;跨轨道的地块是描述性的,而不是领导板的排名。

blocks.en: 4.5 Cost and Scalability Audit
blocks.zh: 4.5 费用和可扩展性审计

blocks.en:
For every scene we log wall-clock construction time, human interaction time, model/API and GPU cost, number of agent iterations, repair count, and acceptance outcome.
We compare the full pipeline against manual-from-scratch authoring and reconstruction without agentic assistance on a representative subset.
The main construction result reports cost per accepted scene, not cost per attempted scene.
blocks.zh:
对于每个场景,我们记录了墙钟的构造时间,人类交互时间,模型/API和GPU的成本,代理迭代次数,修复计数,以及接受结果.
我们比较了整个管道与手动抄写和重建工作,而没有在代表性子集中提供代理援助。
主要施工结果报告每个被接受的场景的成本,而不是每个尝试的场景的成本.

blocks.en: 4.6 Splits and Leakage
blocks.zh: 4.6 分块和泄漏

blocks.en:
Splits are disjoint in physical location, captured trajectory, asset identity, and human/robot motion.
Appearance references are separated from scored target frames by viewpoint or time while preserving the scene’s material and illumination setting.
For dynamic scenes, reference images exclude the scored motion interval, and the exact target camera path is never included among the references.
We additionally reserve a held-out proxy renderer.
If public assets or pretrained reconstruction models may have seen the capture location, this is disclosed; exact benchmark captures and camera paths remain held out.
blocks.zh:
分块在物理位置、被捕获的轨迹、资产身份和人/机器人运动方面是脱节的。
外观参考书目通过视角或时间与得分目标框架相分离,同时保留场景的材料和照明设定.
对于动态场景,参考图像排除了得分的运动间隔,精确的目标相机路径从未包括在参考中.
我们还保留了备用代理制造器
如果公共资产或经过预先培训的重建模型可能已经看到捕获地点,则予以披露;准确的基准捕获和相机路径仍然被保留。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Paired-reference results against the aligned real target videos. Seedance 2.5 is evaluated using its ( 0 , 0 ) (0,0) -aligned output.
blocks.zh: 表2:与对齐的真实目标视频对比的Paired参考结果. 种子2.5用它的(0,0)-对齐输出来评价.

blocks.en: 5 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 5 评价议定书

blocks.en: 5.1 Paired Real-Video Reference
blocks.zh: 5.1 真实录像参考

blocks.en:
Every generated video Y ^ 1 : T \hat{Y}_{1:T} is evaluated against its frame-aligned real target Y gt 1 : T Y^{\mathrm{gt}}_{1:T} .
All comparisons use the released validity masks, and the same preprocessing or estimator is applied to the generated and real videos.
The renderer annotations are used to define valid support and diagnostic subsets, not as a replacement for the real-video reference.
blocks.zh:
每个生成的视频 Y^ 1 : T\hat{Y}_{1:T} 对照其帧相匹配的真目标 Y gt 1 : T Y^{\ mathrm{gt}}_{1:T} 进行评价 : 。 。 。 。
所有比较都使用所发布的有效性口罩,同样的预处理或估计器被应用于生成的和真实的视频.
渲染器说明用于定义有效的支持和诊断子集,而不是取而代之的真视频参考.

blocks.en: 5.2 Appearance Fidelity
blocks.zh: 5.2 外观

blocks.en:
We measure perceptual similarity using masked LPIPS [ 23 ] and report lower values as better.
We additionally compute masked MS-SSIM-GT between each generated frame and its aligned real target [ 21 ] , together with CIEDE2000 color error [ 15 ] .
MS-SSIM-GT measures luminance, contrast, and structural agreement across multiple spatial scales, while LPIPS captures perceptual discrepancy and Lab error isolates color mismatch.
blocks.zh:
我们用蒙面的LPIPS[23]测量知觉相似性,并报告较低的值更好.
我们还在每一个生成的框架及其对齐的实际目标[21]之间,连同CIEDE2000颜色错误[15]之间,计算出被蒙住的MS-SSIM-GT。
MS-SSIM-GT在多个空间尺度上测量亮度,对比度,结构一致度,而LPIPS捕捉到知觉相差和Lab出错会分离出色彩相差.

blocks.en: 5.3 Structural Fidelity
blocks.zh: 5.3 结构优势

blocks.en:
Following the edge, depth, and segmentation dimensions of PAI-Bench-C [ 24 ] , we apply identical projections to Y ^ \hat{Y} and Y gt Y^{\mathrm{gt}} and report tolerant Edge F1, estimated-depth si-RMSE, and Instance mIoU.
Edge matching uses a small spatial tolerance to avoid penalizing sub-pixel registration error.
Depth is compared after the scale convention used by PAI-Bench-C, and masks are aggregated per instance so that large backgrounds cannot hide missing small objects.
We additionally report instance detection coverage for objects that cannot be matched in the generated video; coverage is a diagnostic quantity reported alongside, but not merged into, the main table.
blocks.zh:
根据PAI-Bench-C [24] 的边缘、深度和分化维度,我们对 Y ^\ hat{Y} 和 Y gt Y → mathrm{gt} 应用相同的预测,并报告宽容的边缘F1、 估计深度 si- RMSE 和 Ectory mIoU。
边缘匹配使用一个小空间相容性来避免惩罚子像素注册错误.
深度在PAI-Bench-C使用的规模会后进行比较,口罩按实例汇总,这样大背景不能隐藏缺失的小对象.
此外,我们还报告了无法在生成的视频中匹配的物体的检测范围;覆盖面是一个诊断数量,与主要表格一起报告,但没有合并。

blocks.en: 5.4 Motion Fidelity
blocks.zh: 5.4 积极性

blocks.en:
The same tracker and landmark detector are applied to the generated and real videos.
We report object-normalized trajectory error and track coverage for rigid objects, articulated joints, hands, and robot end effectors.
These are paired-reference measurements: no reference-free temporal quality or warping score is used.
blocks.zh:
同样的追踪器和地标探测器被应用于生成的和真实的视频.
我们报告物体正常轨迹误差 以及刚性物体的轨迹覆盖 接头、手和机器人端效应器
这些是配对的参考测量:没有使用无参考时间质量或分数.

blocks.en: 5.5 Aggregation and Diagnostic Slices
blocks.zh: 5.5 综合诊断片段

blocks.en:
Metrics are aggregated over valid frames within a run, then over seeds and scenes; confidence intervals are obtained by bootstrap resampling scenes.
Primary values are accompanied by slices over foreground and background, object size, visibility, rigid and articulated parts, and low- and high-motion intervals.
We retain the individual measurements and do not combine them into a single score.
blocks.zh:
量子在跑道内通过有效框架相加,再由种子和场景相加;信心间隔通过靴子圈再生场景得到.
主要值伴有前景和背景的切片,物体大小,能见度,刚性与清晰的部分,以及低和高运动间隔.
我们保留了个别的测量,不将它们合并为一个分数.

blocks.en: 6 Experiments
blocks.zh: 6个实验

blocks.en: 6.1 Research Questions
blocks.zh: 6.1 研究问题

blocks.en: Q1: Feasibility. Can the proposed workflow produce accepted real-scene digital twins at substantially lower human time and total cost than conventional authoring? Q2: Benchmark value. Do paired real-video and scene annotations reveal where similar aggregate scores arise from different transfer failures? Q3: Model capability. Which transfer models best reproduce the referenced real appearance while preserving the geometry and dynamics of the input video? Q4: Generalization. Do conclusions persist across unseen scenes, motions, and proxy renderers?
blocks.zh: 问题1:可行性。 拟议的工作流程能否在人类时间和总成本大大低于传统作者的情况下产生可接受的真实数码双胞胎? 问题2:基准值。 配对的真-视频和场景说明是否显示不同传输故障产生类似汇总分数的地方? Q3:模型能力. 哪些传输模型在保存输入视频几何和动态的同时,最好地复制被引用的真实外观? 问题4:概论. 是否在不为人知的场景、动作和代理渲染器中坚持着结论?

blocks.en: 6.2 Digital-Twin Construction Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.2 数字双向建筑评价

blocks.en:
Table 1 reports the release scale, file-integrity checks, environment-edit audits, and proxy-quality diagnostics.
Of 14 registered samples, 12 are released, yielding an 85.7% retention rate and 1,496 paired real–proxy frames at 30 fps.
All released scenes pass frame-count, manifest-hash, background-coverage, shadow-response, visual-inspection, and edit-isolation checks.
We additionally report scene-level intervals for estimated depth and instance agreement to expose variation hidden by aggregate proxy scores.
blocks.zh:
表1报告发行规模、档案完整性检查、环境编辑审计和代理质量诊断。
在14个已登记的样本中,有12个已放出,其留存率为85.7%,在30英尺高空时有1 496个真-正配框。
所有公布的场景均通过帧计数,显示-hash,背景覆盖,阴影响应,可视化检查,并进行编辑-同化检查.
我们还报告场景水平的间隔,估计深度和实例协议,以揭露汇总代用分数所隐藏的变化。

blocks.en: 6.3 Transfer Evaluation
blocks.zh: 6.3 转让评价

blocks.en:
We evaluate representative structured-control and general video-reference systems: Cosmos-Transfer2.5 [ 10 ] , Wan2.2-VACE-Fun-A14B [ 1 ] , MiniMax H3 [ 8 ] , and Seedance 2.5 [ 2 ] .
The first two populate the structured-control track; H3 and Seedance populate the video-reference/editing track; any model supporting multiple interfaces is evaluated in each applicable track.
Within each track, models receive identical appearance-reference budgets, source geometry renders, duration, resolution, and geometry-channel budgets; no model receives explicit camera information, and stochastic models use multiple runs.
Primary results are reported in Table 2 .
Figure 4 provides a qualitative comparison on representative scenes.
blocks.zh:
我们评价有代表性的结构化控制和一般视频参考系统: Cosmos-Transfer2.5 [10],Wan2.2-VACE-Fun-A14B [1],MiniMax H3 [8],和种子2.5 [2].
前两款为结构化控制轨迹;H3和种子为视频参考/编辑轨迹;任何支持多界面的模型都在每个适用的轨迹中进行评估.
在每道内,模型都得到相同的外观参考预算,源几何制作,持续时间,分辨率,和几何通道预算;没有模型得到明显的相机信息,而相片模型使用多跑.
主要结果见表2。
图4提供了代表性场景的质量比较。

blocks.en:
Figure 4 : Qualitative comparison on representative paired scenes.
The proxy input specifies geometry and motion, while the held-out real target provides the ground-truth video for evaluation.
Zoomed regions highlight structural, articulation, and appearance failures that may be obscured by aggregate scores.
blocks.zh:
图4:代表性成对场景定性比较.
代理输入指定了几何和运动,而被搁置的真正目标则提供了用于评价的地真视频.
被放大的区域突出了结构、表达和外观的失败,这些失败可能被总分所掩盖。

blocks.en: 6.4 Paired-Scene Diagnostic Analysis
blocks.zh: 6.4 Paired-场景诊断分析

blocks.en:
We use accepted scene annotations to partition paired-reference errors by object size, visibility, articulation, and motion.
Controlled perturbations to camera pose, object placement, joint angle, blur, texture, and detail test whether these diagnostic slices respond to the intended failure.
We report sensitivity to perturbation severity and agreement with the corresponding appearance, structural, or trajectory metric rather than introducing an additional ranking score.
blocks.zh:
我们用被接受的场景说明 来区分成对的参考错误 按对象大小、能见度、表达和运动
被控制的扰动到相机姿势,物体位置,关节角,模糊,纹理,以及细节测试这些诊断片是否响应了预期的失败.
我们报告对扰动严重程度的敏感性,并赞同相应的外观、结构或轨迹度量,而不是引入额外的排名分数。

blocks.en: 6.5 Generalization and Human Validation
blocks.zh: 6.5 一般化和人类验证

blocks.en:
Results are stratified by construction error, motion, occlusion, articulation, reflective/transparent materials, and held-out renderer.
Human raters answer separate questions about real-scene resemblance, structural faithfulness, fine detail, and temporal artifacts.
We correlate each judgment with its corresponding metric and report scene-bootstrap confidence intervals.
blocks.zh:
成果通过施工出错、运动、闭塞、发音、反射/透明材料和被搁置的渲染器分级。
人类评分者分别回答关于真实场景相似性,结构忠实性,细微细节,以及时间文物的问题.
我们把每一项判断与相应的度量和报告 场景-陷阱的置信间隔联系起来。

blocks.en: 7 Discussion and Limitations
blocks.zh: 7 讨论和限制

blocks.en:
Agentic 3D authoring can accelerate scene construction but can still choose an incorrect asset, conceal a discrepancy with appearance, or create invalid topology.
It therefore produces candidates, while calibrated observations and acceptance tests determine benchmark inclusion.
blocks.zh:
代理 3D 作者可以加速场景构建,但仍可以选择不正确的资产,隐藏与外观的差异,或者创建无效的地貌.
因此,它产生候选人,而校准的观察和验收测试则确定是否列入基准。

blocks.en:
No reconstructed scene is identical to reality.
We publish uncertainty and validity support, exclude unresolved regions, and analyze how benchmark conclusions change across stricter acceptance thresholds.
Claims concern fidelity to an accepted twin and its registered capture, not complete recovery of hidden physical state.
blocks.zh:
没有重建的场景与现实完全相同.
我们公布不确定性和有效性支持,排除未解决的区域,并分析基准结论如何改变更严格的接受阈值。
索赔涉及对被接受的双胞胎的忠诚及其注册俘虏,而不是完全恢复隐藏的身体状态。

blocks.en:
Even with a matched camera path, exposure, rolling shutter, motion blur, transparent surfaces, and non-Lambertian effects complicate pixel alignment.
Multi-scale metrics and validity masks reduce but do not eliminate this problem.
blocks.zh:
即使在相机路径相匹配的情况下,曝光,滚动的百叶窗,运动模糊而透明的表面,以及非兰伯特效应也使像素对齐变得复杂.
多尺度度量衡和有效性口罩减少但不能消除这一问题。

blocks.en: The construction audit reports failure rate, human time, total cost, and comparison with manual authoring, since successful examples alone do not establish a scalable benchmark pipeline.
blocks.zh: 建筑审计报告故障率,人的时间,总成本,以及同人工作者的比较,因为仅靠成功的例子并不能建立可扩展的基准管道.

blocks.en:
The first release focuses on scenes that can pass geometric and temporal validation.
Fluids, deformable objects, outdoor crowds, severe occlusion, and uninstrumented fast motion remain difficult.
We expose this selection bias in the dataset statistics and per-category results.
blocks.zh:
第一次发布的重点是能够通过几何和时间验证的场景.
流体,可变形物体,户外人群,严重隐蔽,无器能快活动作仍然困难.
我们揭露了数据集统计和每个类别结果中的这种选择偏差。

blocks.en:
Structured controls and general video references expose different amounts and kinds of information.
A single pooled ranking would confound model quality with conditioning bandwidth.
Track-specific reporting and matched information budgets improve fairness, but cannot make closed natural-language interfaces exactly equivalent to explicit geometry controls.
blocks.zh:
结构化控制和一般视频参考显示的信息数量和种类不同。
单一的集合排名将使模型质量与调节带宽相混淆。
专轨报告和相匹配的信息预算提高了公正性,但不能使封闭的自然语言界面完全等同于明确的几何控制.

blocks.en:
Real captures, reconstructed locations, 3D assets, and human motion require explicit permissions and compatible release terms.
We remove identifying biometric and location information where consent does not cover public release.
blocks.zh:
真实的捕捉,重建地点,3D资产,以及人类运动需要明确的许可和相容的放出条件.
我们删除了生物鉴别和地点信息,如果同意并不包括公开释放。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
Render-to-real generation has advanced faster than the data needed to evaluate it.
We introduced RenderBench around the missing substrate: held-out real appearance references and ground-truth target videos paired with validated, editable, and dynamically registered 3D twins.
Recent visual-geometry, neural-reconstruction, and assisted authoring systems reduce the cost of producing candidate scenes.
Independent geometric gates then provide distinct appearance conditions, paired real-video targets, and renderer-native scene annotations.
We evaluate transfer quality against paired real target videos, retain PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections, and use scene annotations to localize errors across objects, visibility, articulation, and motion.
The audited release contains 12 accepted scenes and 1,496 paired real–proxy frames, with complete frame-count and SHA-256 verification across all released files.
Environment edits preserve foreground, camera, and animation hashes in every scene, and the measured proxy diagnostics establish a transparent baseline for interpreting downstream transfer results.
blocks.zh:
成真发电比评价所需的数据进步得更快。
我们引入了Render Bench 围绕缺失的底物: 被搁置的真实的外表参考 和地面真实的目标视频 与有效,可编辑,动态注册的 三维双胞胎。
近期的视觉几何,神经再造,以及协助的编剧系统降低了制作候选场景的成本.
然后,独立的几何门提供独特的外观条件,配对真实的视频目标,以及渲染器-原生场景说明.
使用场景说明来区分对象、能见度、表达和运动之间的错误。
